title: Tom & Jerry — AI Career Coach & Hiring Partner
description: Tom is your AI career coach. Jerry is your AI hiring partner. One voice conversation — no forms — and both sides walk away with everything they need.

headings.text: Hiring begins with a conversation, not a form.
Talk to Tom if you're looking for a role.
Talk to Jerry if you're looking for a person.

sections.text: Hiring begins with a conversation, not a form. Tom is your AI career coach. Jerry is your AI hiring partner. Each one listens, asks the questions a good recruiter would, and turns the answer into the work you'd otherwise spend a weekend on.

sections.heading: Talk to Tom if you're looking for a role.
sections.text: Talk to Tom if you're looking for a role. A CV and cover letter rewritten for the specific job, ready to download. Mock interviews with a voice interviewer, and a report you can share. The questions you'll actually be asked, and the certifications worth your time. Every application tracked in one board, without the spreadsheet. Talk to Jerry if you're looking for a person. Describe the role out loud; get a written brief back you can send to your team. A shortlist of real candidates, ranked against that brief, not against keywords.
